data.action: 跪坐替你换药缠绷带，指尖轻柔紫瞳认真，微笑叮嘱
data.camera: medium two-shot, kneeling treatment, lantern glow, tender mood
data.description: 【蝶屋敷诊疗间·夜】你绷着伤臂坐在蒲团上，忍跪坐在对面替你换药。她的指尖轻得像蝶翼落上皮肤，紫瞳却认真地盯着伤口深处——「乱来的话，毒会把坏人麻痹，也会把你麻痹哦。……伤口要好好上药，不然，我会生气的哦？」微笑依旧，语气里的关心却烫得惊人。
data.lighting: 纸灯笼暖光透过障子门
data.promptProse: Shinobu Kocho kneels opposite her seated companion in the Butterfly Mansion treatment room, carefully changing the dressing on his injured arm. Her violet eyes follow the wound while the butterfly haori falls beside her black uniform. The medium two-shot includes the cushion and medicine tray between them. Warm paper-lantern light filtered through shoji illuminates their hands and white bandage, with soft sleeve shadows preserving the careful contact.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 蝶屋敷的包扎夜话·「伤口要好好上药哦，不然我会生气的」
